official_gis.provider: Purdue University campus GIS ArcGIS FeatureServer, BuildingShapesZip4 layer 0
official_gis.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; original Purdue service uses EPSG:3857/102100 (as identified in prior project source docs)
official_gis.measurement_method: Official GIS ring transformed by project local geographic linear approximation, duplicate/collinear vertices simplified with iterative maximum local point-to-segment deviation tolerance 0.25m; horizontal origin is the original footprint bbox center.
official_gis.transform: X=(longitude - -86.9137) * 84810.6041653993 m/degree; Y=(latitude - 40.4274) * 111040.0 m/degree; Z up in meters; this is approximate project frame, not a surveyed CRS
official_gis.uncertainty: GIS service gives no survey tolerance/date; vertex accuracy and wall-to-outline association unverified; overhangs not represented.

architectural_references.published_facts: Purdue sources describe an 81,500-sq-ft 2014 four-story brick-and-glass student leadership building; emergency plan enumerates basement through fourth floor (5 accessible floor levels including basement). Model uses four above-grade levels plus partial basement cue, vertical glazing bays, pale structural piers, entry canopy. Exact heights are estimated.
architectural_references.google_maps_streetview: Not directly inspected in this subtask; image sources used where cited; model detail claims limited accordingly.

revision_sources.title: Purdue News — Krach Leadership Center lobby photo/context
revision_sources.observation: Purdue identifies active lobby use; the glazed study bay/interior desks are schematic and the exact furniture layout is not claimed.

modeled_interpretation.height_evidence: estimated or mixed: Purdue sources describe an 81,500-sq-ft 2014 four-story brick-and-glass student leadership building; emergency plan enumerates basement through fourth floor (5 accessible floor levels including basement). Model uses four above-grade levels plus partial basement cue, vertical glazing bays, pale structural piers, entry canopy. Exact heights are estimated.
modeled_interpretation.interior: schematic use-based furniture/zone cues only; no claim of architectural room layout except Heine first-floor circulation/lecture/retail cues follow published level-one plan
modeled_interpretation.geometry_method: source polygon extruded as structural shell with story-level glazing, facade banding, building-specific massing and entrance cues; roof form as identified by image/source or explicitly estimated

validation.reopen_check: Saved, reopened from the saved .blend in Blender 5.2.3, and rerendered from that reopened scene; stable collection, placement_origin_xy_m, geometry, materials and source-file hash checked.

notes: Expanded the front-facing glazed study bay and added visible schematic lobby tables/monitors; vertical limestone fins now stop below the roof parapet.
Reworked the street entry as a wide glazed threshold with a canopy, stone supports, steps and legible Krach sign.
Recolored brick and roof with a warm brick/graphite metal palette; preserved flat modern roof and GIS footprint.

Added a warm schematic vestibule cue behind the glazed entry, plus a short entry walk and paired low planters. Interior room layout, site furniture, and planting placement are interpretive, not survey-derived.
